items_flat.title_en: Sam Altman Demonstrates ChatGPT Work Completing Complex Multi-Step Agentic Tasks from Mobile
items_flat.title_zh: Sam Altman 示範 ChatGPT Work 從手機完成複雜多步驟代理任務
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman posted that ChatGPT Work is “remarkable” and that “work” undersells it. From his phone he prompted it to use all his chat history to generate long-weekend trip ideas for eight friends, plan the best three options, build a full-stack coordination site, reach group agreement, make reservations, and draft a Gmail email—and it “just worked.”
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI執行長Sam Altman發文表示ChatGPT Work「remarkable」，「work」一詞還低估了它。他從手機下達指令：利用全部聊天歷史為8位朋友構思長週末行程、規劃最佳三方案、建立全端協調網站、達成共識後訂位，並草擬Gmail郵件——結果「就這樣完成了」。
items_flat.analysis_en: This real-user demonstration from the CEO underscores the maturing reliability of agentic workflows that chain research, coding, external actions and communication without constant human oversight. Key uncertainty remains how consistently such complex, multi-app tasks succeed for ordinary users versus high-token privileged accounts, and how safety guardrails interact with long-horizon autonomy.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 執行長親自展示的真實使用案例，凸顯代理式工作流在研究、程式碼、外部操作與溝通串接上的成熟度。關鍵不確定性在於這類複雜多應用任務對一般用戶的成功率是否與高額度帳號一致，以及安全護欄如何與長時程自主行為互動。
items_flat.quote: chatgpt work is remarkable, and "work" undersells it. ... it...just worked.
items_flat.quote_zh: chatgpt work is remarkable, and "work" undersells it. ... it...just worked.

items_flat.title_en: xAI / Elon Musk Promote Grok Build CLI Updates Including Tutorial and Voice Prompting
items_flat.title_zh: xAI／Elon Musk 推廣 Grok Build CLI 更新，新增教學與語音提示
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted multiple times promoting Grok Build, highlighting a new /tutorial command, voice prompting (Ctrl+Space), reliability improvements, workflow progress tracking and one-click resume for failed runs. He also shared a short video under “Grok Imagine.”
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk多次發文推廣Grok Build，強調新增 /tutorial 指令、語音提示（Ctrl+Space）、可靠性改進、工作流進度追蹤與失敗任務一鍵恢復等功能，並分享「Grok Imagine」短影片。
items_flat.analysis_en: These incremental CLI and interaction updates reinforce xAI’s focus on practical developer tooling and agent reliability rather than a new frontier model release. The emphasis on voice and guided onboarding may lower the barrier for non-expert users of coding agents, though the exact performance gains versus prior versions remain unbenchmarked in the posts.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些CLI與互動的漸進更新凸顯xAI持續強化實用開發者工具與代理可靠性，而非發布新一代前沿模型。語音與引導式教學可能降低非專家使用編碼代理的門檻，但貼文中尚未提供與前版本的量化效能比較。
items_flat.quote: Download Grok Build and type /tutorial https://x.ai/cli
items_flat.quote_zh: Download Grok Build and type /tutorial https://x.ai/cli

brief_en: Quiet day for major frontier lab model launches or official blog posts in the last 12 hours. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman highlighted ChatGPT Work’s advanced multi-step agentic performance with a real-world phone prompt that planned a group trip, built a coordination site, made reservations and drafted email. xAI continued promoting Grok Build tooling updates.
brief_zh: 過去12小時AI大廠無重大模型發布或官方部落格公告。OpenAI執行長Sam Altman示範ChatGPT Work強大的多步驟代理能力，從手機完成複雜行程規劃、全端網站建置、訂位與郵件草稿。xAI持續推廣Grok Build工具更新。
